sample.question:
2048 Slide is a sliding-merge puzzle on a square grid. Rows are numbered from 0 at the top downward and columns from 0 at the left rightward, so a cell is written (row, column). One move slides ALL tiles as far as possible in the chosen direction (left, right, up or down). When two tiles with the SAME number collide during the slide, they merge into one tile whose value is their sum; the pair closest to the destination wall merges first, a freshly merged tile cannot merge again in the same move, and merging scores points equal to the new tile's value. In this variant NO new tile appears after a move, so the board changes only by sliding and merging.

What is the value of the tile at cell (1, 2)? If the cell is empty, answer 0.
sample.analysis:
Reading the board: row 0: [4, 8, -]; row 1: [2, 4, -]; row 2: [16, -, 16].
The cell at row 1, column 2 is empty, so the value is 0.
So the answer is 0.

state_content.coordinate_system: (row, col); row 0 is the top row, col 0 is the leftmost column
state_content.rule_note: deterministic variant: no random tile spawns after a move; merge score equals merged tile value
